SWZ.note: The document states no exchange of records between the civil register and the ID system.
No count or share of people holding the ID is given.
A birth certificate and ID card were issued eight days apart in one case, which does not state a number given at birth.
Who operates or maintains the system is not stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is mentioned.

facts.fact: Eswatini's Civil Service Commission found a Home Affairs registrar guilty of unlawfully processing a birth certificate and a national identity card for a foreign national, the card being issued on about 2024-02-20, eight days after the birth certificate was registered.
